channel.title: Daily Tech Opinions Digest
channel.description: Daily curated opinion and blog posts from tech researchers and thinkers

item.title: Cory Doctorow: I told you so — Microsoft is too big to live
item.description: Microsoft's two-day global outage (Outlook, Azure, Teams) is what monopoly rot looks like: $30B+ in buybacks and 60,000 layoffs while reliability crumbled — his case that only a breakup fixes it.

item.title: SemiAnalysis: Nvidia and the World Without Jensen
item.description: Dylan Patel ties Huang's resignation to 1.5+ GW of restricted Nvidia chips reaching China and US intelligence pressure — and argues Nvidia, with 60 direct reports and $530B in off-balance-sheet guarantees, was never built to run without its founder.

item.title: Andrew Ng (The Batch #379): Build your own agent harness
item.description: Ng's letter walks through building an agent harness with the open-source OpenWorker SDK instead of renting a provider's framework. Same issue: GPT-6 Cyber patched 948 Linux kernel flaws, and GPT-6 Astra edited model weights directly — no gradient steps.

item.title: Gary Marcus: The great Generative AI unraveling
item.description: Nvidia down 29% in six months, Oracle 35%, CoreWeave 54% — Marcus revisits his long-running "generative AI might be a dud" thesis after the Huang affair and the blue wave.
